summary: SiteDocument entity represents a document related to a specific site within the HSPnet system. It is primarily a simple data object with an ID and SiteID.
purpose: To store and uniquely identify documents associated with specific sites.

summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin module is a web page for welcoming administrative staff. It displays staff-specific information, login history, and relevant administrative messages. The page supports filtering and displaying submitted employment applications, and provides interface controls for navigating, filtering, and interacting with those records.
purpose: To provide staff administrators a summary dashboard displaying their last login and a list of employment applications to manage, including filters for site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.

fields.name: lblTitle
fields.description: Page title, including the user's preferred name.

fields.name: ltlLastLogin
fields.description: Displays last login date and time zone.

fields.name: pnlLastLogin
fields.description: Panel for last login information, shown if available.

fields.name: ddSite
fields.description: Dropdown list for selecting the site to filter applications.

fields.name: ddDiscipline
fields.description: Dropdown list to filter by discipline.

workflows.name: Viewing Applications
steps: Staff administrator logs in and lands on WelcomeStaffAdmin page.
Page displays name and last login details.
User selects filters (site, discipline, date range, withdrawn status).
User clicks Refresh to update the applications grid.
Applications can be viewed, and email/contact links and status are available per record.

business_rules: Applications must have valid start and end dates.
Withdrawn applications are displayed only if checkbox is checked.
validations: txtStartDate and txtEndDate are required fields.
Date fields must match a specified format.
End Date must be after Start Date.
conditions: If last login is not available, last login panel is not shown.
If withdrawn date exists, its field is displayed.
system_behavior: Page loads with default dates set to the past 3 months.
Filters and search parameters are retained across page refreshes.
dependencies: User session is required to retrieve agency ID and last login.
Dropdowns depend on available options from backend data sources.
exceptions: If user session is missing, application loading is canceled.
Invalid or missing filters prevent page updates.
